assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One inventory item icon for an original cozy medieval hand-painted storybook game. Square canvas with TRUE transparent alpha background, no painted backdrop or checkerboard. One ordinary rustic object only, centered and fully inside generous 10% transparent padding; longest dimension occupies 80% of square, clean legible silhouette when reduced to 256x256. Warm gouache/watercolor brush texture and softly inked dark-brown edges match the supplied existing game illustration, but simplify tiny surface noise and use clear large forms. Soft light from UPPER LEFT, subtle lower-right shading and only an extremely faint small contact shadow. Object should look mundane and worn; exactly one understated magical hint, no spectacular effects, no aura cloud. Not pixel art, anime, flat vector, glossy 3D or photorealistic. No letters, numbers, writing, logos, words, speech bubble, badge background, decorative frame or border. Object fills most of the square without touching edges. ITEM pot: a single battered rusty brown iron cooking pot, round belly, two small side handles, chipped rim, visible open interior from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. No lid, no food and no extra utensils. Hidden identity is a holy grail: just a very faint warm golden reflection INSIDE the empty bowl, easy to miss. Humble village cookware, not a ornate goblet.
